summary: Completed comprehensive security and functionality testing for IDunnoPoetry admin authentication system. Token-based auth is working correctly - all admin endpoints require valid Bearer token, rate limiting on login (10 attempts/5 min) is functioning, and export URLs accept token via query param. Two minor frontend bugs were fixed.
seed_data_creation: 3 test comments created during security testing
